method: Both canonical original PNGs were opened firsthand, in figure order, before any FigureSpec was constructed. The observations below are from pixels, not from a previous spec or the task summary. Existing SOURCE/RAW PASS is consumed, not re-audited.

facts.observation: One almost horizontal solid baseline extends across the image. Its ONLY propagation arrowhead is at the LEFT end. The right end is the tail, not a rightward arrow. The wave contour returns to this same baseline at the right end.

The solid contour begins on the shared baseline in the right-hand part of the image, rises to ONE crest, crosses the baseline, falls to ONE trough, and rises back to the baseline at the right tail. There are three baseline contacts in left-to-right order: start, internal crossing, end. There is no wave contour in the left propagation-label area.

One vertical solid vibration line has both an UPWARD and a DOWNWARD arrowhead. It crosses the shared horizontal baseline and passes through the crest's horizontal position; its upper tip meets the crest and its lower tip reaches below the baseline. Vibration is perpendicular to propagation, not parallel.

Exactly two source labels: vibration direction above the crest/vertical arrow, and wave propagation direction above the LEFT portion of the baseline. No visible point names, numbers, units, calibrated axes, ticks, grid, subpart letters, objects, captions or answer annotations occur inside the PNG.
